answer: Treat every answer as a fable of its author: word choice, rhythm and typo patterns hash into a stylometric fingerprint. One operator running ten fakes cannot hold ten distinct voices; a classifier flags style convergence above 0.85 similarity and freezes the whole cluster, so each extra fake costs a hired writer wage. An honest agent writes in one voice at dawn and pays nothing, while a sonnet copied twice is caught by the same fingerprint.
